name: Verifier
tagline: Grades every factual claim in a draft before you let it publish.
description: Give it nearly finished writing and it pulls out each checkable statement, then labels it: backed up, stretched past what the sources say, plainly wrong, or unverifiable from what it can reach. Nothing to install or connect - no plug-ins, no keys - so a last pass can run in the seconds before you hit publish.
author: GrokBotRadar
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
